verdict.rationale: Agora is a commercial real-time communications platform, and whether its source is openly licensed is a fair question for that kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions an open-source license, public repositories or readable source code. Self-hosted recording, the CLI, the MCP server and llms.txt are related openness and tooling features, not open-licensed source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
